import_provenance.original_statement: For every coinfinite computably enumerable low₂ set A, is the lattice of its computably enumerable supersets modulo finite difference isomorphic to the entire lattice of computably enumerable sets modulo finite difference? Here low₂ means A″ has the same Turing degree as the double jump of the computable sets.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The authors explicitly state that earlier claims of a full proof have not settled the conjecture; their 2025 theorem establishes important special cases involving hyperhypersimple supersets.
